blocks.text: If we have a continuous charge distribution characterised by a charge density ρ (r), we divide it, as before, into small volume elements each of size Δυ and carrying a charge ρΔυ. We then determine the potential due to each volume element and sum (strictly speaking , integrate) over all such contributions, and thus determine the potential due to the entire distribution.
